prompt: Create a sales dashboard as a single HTML page for our Q3 numbers. Revenue was $4.2M (up 18% QoQ), 312 new customers, churn 2.1%, pipeline $9.8M. Break revenue down by region (NA 52%, EMEA 31%, APAC 17%) and show the monthly trend Jul/Aug/Sep: 1.2M, 1.4M, 1.6M. Top 5 reps table too, make up plausible names.
assertions: A single HTML file is saved in outputs
The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
No placeholder text or obviously fake names (lorem ipsum, John Doe)
Chart or section titles state a finding rather than only a topic
